decisions.subject: Muhlenbergia dubia E.Fourn.
decisions.proposed_decision: ACCEPTED at species rank in Poaceae; retain existing canonical binomial
decisions.detail: Published in Mexic. Pl. 2:82 (1886); Kew/WCVP and ITIS concur.

decisions.subject: Muhlenbergia rigens (Benth.) Hitchc.
decisions.proposed_decision: Distinct accepted species; not a synonym of M. dubia
decisions.detail: FNA differentiates via panicle density, ligule length, anther color and lemma length.

decisions.subject: Muhlenbergia dubia authorship and rank
decisions.proposed_decision: Use E.Fourn.; rank species, genus Muhlenbergia, family Poaceae
decisions.detail: Accepted name already matches canonical authority.

decisions.subject: Muhlenbergia piniflora source label
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject automatic botanical synonym mapping to M. dubia
decisions.detail: Not in the 7 POWO/WCVP listed synonyms. Project draft flags it as an unverified erroneous source label; absence in this source alone does not prove name was never published.

decisions.subject: Muhlenbergia dubia vs. M. rigens
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject automatic merger or specimen relabeling
decisions.detail: Both accepted separately; morphology may overlap without measured reproductive details.

decisions.subject: Original piniflora-labelled source observation
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve source provenance and existing scientific hold; do not silently reassign individual observation
decisions.detail: The common-name inference Pine Muhly -> M. dubia is not voucher-level confirmation of the original observation.

decisions.subject: Specimen and image identity under M. dubia
decisions.detail: FNA diagnostic characters: ligule 4–10 mm, glumes about 2–3 mm, lemmas 3.8–5 mm; species-labelled habit images do not by themselves resolve all distinctions from M. rigens. No hybrid ancestry verified.

decisions.subject: Identity of historical project label Muhlenbergia piniflora
decisions.proposed_decision: Source-label interpretation unresolved pending original provenance and voucher review
decisions.detail: Do not treat as a valid published synonym solely because Pine Muhly is a common name of M. dubia; historical source row must remain traceable.

sources.authority: Flora of North America treatment, Paul M. Peterson, hosted Open Herbarium
